data.name: Raktaksha
data.gender_notes: Raktaksha is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Raktaksha is recorded with the meaning “Lord of Blood”. Raktaksha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lord of Blood”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. in_sanskrit.name: रक्तक्ष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who protects from blood loss or related issues.

in_hindi.name: रक्तक्ष
in_hindi.meaning: रक्त (rakta) - रक्ति (rakti) - blood, क्ष (ksha) - कारक (karak) - doer, साक्षी (saakshi) - witness or protector
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who protects or witnesses from blood loss or related issues.

in_tamil.name: ரக்தக்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who protects from blood loss or related issues.

in_telugu.name: రక్తక్ష
in_telugu.meaning: రక్త (rakta) - blood, క్ష (ksha) - పోజే (poje) - doer, శీళజీ (shilaji) - protector
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who protects or heals from blood loss or related issues.

in_marathi.name: Raktaksha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Blood
in_marathi.long_meaning: Raktaksha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Raktaksha is a name given to Lord Rama, signifying his role as the protector against bloodshed and war. The name Raktaksha is derived from Sanskrit words 'Rakta' meaning blood and 'aksha' meaning guardian or protector.

in_bengali.name: Raktaksha
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Blood
in_bengali.long_meaning: Raktaksha একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। In Hindu mythology, Raktaksha is a name given to Lord Rama, signifying his role as the protector against bloodshed and war. The name Raktaksha is derived from Sanskrit words 'Rakta' meaning blood and 'aksha' meaning guardian or protector.
